# Kt Saylor

> UX designer and Marketing Operations Coordinator in Northwest Arkansas, working at the intersection of UX design, data visualization, SEO reporting, and AI workflows. B.S. in Digital Technology and Design (AI/Machine Learning emphasis) at Arkansas State University, minoring in psychology and marketing, expected Fall 2027.

## About
- Current role: Marketing Operations Coordinator at SEO Counselors (Bentonville, AR). Builds monthly client performance reports from Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile, and keyword rank tracking data, and is building a custom MCP server to automate reporting.
- Background: years as a creative director and designer, including owning and running the CatHead Biscuits food truck brand (2016 to 2019).
- Certification: Google UX Design Professional Certificate.
- Focus: how intelligent systems get built and how people use them, with attention to bias, transparency, ethics, and security.

## Projects
- Fiberglass: a UX/UI app concept for checking the fiber makeup of clothing, prototyped in Figma.
- CatHead Biscuits: full brand for a biscuit food truck, from logo and menus to truck graphics, photography, and Instagram.
- SEO Performance Dashboards: one-page monthly client reports generated by a custom Claude skill, with like-for-like metrics and QA checks.
- Luxi Loo Rentals: website for a luxury restroom trailer rental company in Northwest Arkansas and Southwest Missouri.
- Truck Hunters LLC: website for a third-party logistics company (2023).
